name: Soft Apocalypse
summary: Soft Apocalypse is the concept of society collapsing slowly or post catastrophe.
description: Soft Apocalypse is the concept of society collapsing slowly or post catastrophe. Usually characterized by the decline of technology, abandoned cities full of wildlife. The surviving humans would be focused on food, shelter, and having to work together as a community rather than fighting or having to deal with whichever world ending event may be occurring. Any technology they have might be solar, wind, or other renewable energy sources, but it will be limited.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Hope, harmony with nature, anarchy, Nature taking it back.
